External links for this lesson, checked to load on 2026-11-13. Quoted regulatory and program text in
the lesson comes from the local copies in `sources/`, not from these pages.

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.160, Records](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.160)** — the
  BECS records rule (donor number, retention). Use it whenever someone asks whether a research step
  could change what a record is. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 11.10, Controls for closed systems](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/11.10)**
  — the controls that stay attached to the BECS records. Use it to explain why EXT-21 has no write
  permission. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[FDA: Blood Establishment Computer System Validation in the User's Facility](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/blood-establishment-computer-system-validation-users-facility)**
  — the guidance page; section III.I is the regression-analysis passage quoted in the lesson. It is
  guidance ("should"), and it says nothing about research extracts. Verified loading via `curl` on
  2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[Cornell LII: 45 CFR 164.514, Other requirements relating to uses and disclosures of PHI](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/45/164.514)**
  — paragraph (e): the limited data set and the data use agreement contents used for the new-field
  review and DUA scope check. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (CSRC publication page)](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/53/r5/upd1/final)**
  — the voluntary control catalog; read CM-3 and CM-4 for change-control and impact-analysis
  vocabulary. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[NIH Guide: NOT-OD-21-013, Final NIH Policy for Data Management and Sharing](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/notice-files/NOT-OD-21-013.html)**
  — the notice whose definition of scientific data excludes physical specimens (module 4). Use it
  to answer "does the DMS policy govern the samples?" Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13
  (HTTP 200).

- **[NIH RePORTER](https://reporter.nih.gov/)** — the public award database. Search "Recipient
  Epidemiology and Donor Evaluation Study" to read the 2026 REDS contract records, including the REDS
  Brazil abstract that describes a rapid research response capability. Re-check it before relying on
  any later program phase name. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **Earlier lessons this one builds on:**
  [Module 2](../the-vein-to-vein-database-and-research-extracts/index.qmd),
  [Module 5](../security-expectations-for-research-data/index.qmd),
  [Vendor release intake for BECS](../../release-management-and-sdlc/vendor-release-intake-for-becs/index.qmd),
  [Risk-based testing and regression](../../release-management-and-sdlc/risk-based-testing-and-regression/index.qmd),
  [Emergency changes and hotfixes](../../release-management-and-sdlc/emergency-changes-and-hotfixes/index.qmd),
  [ALCOA and data integrity](../../data-integrity-and-records/alcoa-and-data-integrity/index.qmd).

- **[Final NIH Policy on Data Management and Sharing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=84wlI1ru2A4)** (National Human Genome Research Institute) — an NIH institute's video on the data management and sharing policy. It does not cover running research data alongside a regulated system.

**Honest gap.** The 2022 REDS-IV-P design paper excerpt in `sources/` does not mention rapid
response studies. The only source for the capability is the REDS Brazil record in RePORTER, which
describes REDS Brazil. Nothing in this course's sources shows what authorizes a particular hub's
request, so the lesson tells the Director to ask the hub in writing.

## Keep learning

Not official sources, and not authority for any regulatory claim.

- **[Change Impact Analysis with CMDB: Assess Risk (Virima)](https://virima.com/blog/change-impact-analysis-with-cmdb-how-to-assess-risk-before-every-it-change)**
  (vendor blog) — a plain walk through why impact analysis depends on relationship data in the CMDB.
  Read it for the idea, and discount product claims. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13
  (HTTP 200).

- **[Informed Change Management with Integrated CMDB (Servicely)](https://www.servicely.ai/videos/informed-change-management-with-integrated-cmdb)**
  (vendor video page) — a short demo of viewing the configuration items affected by a proposed
  change. A tool demo, not a standard; I did not embed it. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13
  (HTTP 200).

- **[The Book of OHDSI, Chapter 6: Extract Transform Load](https://ohdsi.github.io/TheBookOfOhdsi/ExtractTransformLoad.html)**
  — the OMOP community's practical guide to mapping source data and codes to the model.
  I have not checked what it says about unmapped values. It describes OHDSI practice, not the REDS DCC.
  Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[OHDSI Data Quality Dashboard](https://ohdsi.github.io/DataQualityDashboard/)** — a catalog of
  field-level conformance checks on OMOP data; useful for imagining what the receiving side will
  flag. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
